former_upstream.reason: The upstream maintainer, Brian Mills, left Inside Success on 2026-10-02. The company copy now stands on its own and is the canonical Inside Success repository.

runtime_dependency_reason: This repository does not depend on the former upstream at runtime; public installation must not require private Git credentials.
notes: Inside-Success/open_web_retrieval is canonical for Inside Success. Do not sync from, merge from, cherry-pick from, or open contribution pull requests to the former upstream; it is a separate personal project and is no longer tracked.
The Python package tree may now diverge from the former upstream snapshot; former_upstream records the last integrated revision and its source-tree digest as history only.
Do not make public installation depend on private Git credentials.
